I've written round 289's task. The decision is **CONTINUE**, with FIX-PD-1b next. No app source was changed (store `git status` is empty, HEAD `c345def`).

**Round 288 closed:** C passed it with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true, 11 rows at both viewports and no bugs, and the gate published `c345def`.
- FIX-PD-1a2 is now done (მზადაა) and F9 is closed.
- C-R286-01/02, C-R287-01 and A-R287-PREMIUM-UNVALIDATED are closed. C-R186-01 is also closed under lesson L7, because it had the same cause and round 286 already fixed it.
- The two backend-only rows stay open as evidence for a later check with a backend (BACKEND-EVIDENCE-F9).
- C's architecture note is recorded as a signal only (A-R288-ARCH-LEADING-SPANS); nothing is scheduled from it.

**Round 289, FIX-PD-1b** (F7 Medium + SR-230-6):
- **Names:** the 9 Georgian demo strings become English: Night Pulse · Full mix, Pulse, Bass, Pad, Melody, plus "Middle East — public preview" and "CZABA hero — public preview".
- **Library:** the collection label no longer repeats under every card. It shows once, as a group heading, only when the results contain two or more collections.
- **Override of the product designer:** they proposed a one-line, truncated heading. At the default 144 px library width both labels got cut off, so the heading wraps instead, like the card titles do.
- **Effect:** the five synthetic cards go from 80.25 to 47.25 px tall, and the list's text items drop from 14 to 11, so nothing new becomes permanently visible.
- **Owned files:** the demo data file, `ArrangementLibrary.tsx`, two test pins, a new test file (LG1–LG7 plus mutants M1–M5) and doc 216. Store, auth, protected routes and audio code are frozen.
- **C's checks:** 0 Georgian characters anywhere on the page, the group count and box sizes, keyboard order, the tree/folder/search states, and the add-Bass journey (exact status text, Undo label, clip name, and playback really advancing). Plus a screen-budget count, the auth guard and the doc check.

**Pre-checks I ran:** I applied the change to a scratch copy of `c345def`: typecheck passed, the 14 covering files passed (247 tests), and the whole arrangement and data test folders passed (172 files, 2,607 tests). I also probed the current Studio in the browser. Every claim the task makes about current code is tagged K1–K20 in `claims-289.sh`.

**Questions for Saba (neither blocks the round):**
- Stem names: "Pulse" or "Rhythm", and "Melody" or "Lead" (SABA-Q-FIXPD1B-NAMES). Round 289 ships Pulse and Melody.
- The group heading is a difference from Live, whose manual shows no group headings. Whether Live shows where a search result lives is not confirmed, so I added a measurement request for root (LIVE-MEAS-BROWSER-SEARCH-LOCATION in `user-review/live-checks.md`).

**Queue:** 289 FIX-PD-1b → 290 RETRO → a regression round at the first planning on or after 2026-11-02 → FIX-PD-1c → STUDIO-LINK → NAME-AND-HINT → PERF-3c and the rest. No frontend-architect checkpoint is needed: it is a small change with one owner.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, before writing and before hand-off; I applied all four of its fixes. I also consulted the product designer.
